summary: Frontend-only verification of 5 new broadcast features + regression. All 5 tasks PASS. Task1 Ctrl+Shift+L: opens Broadcast Center, broadcast-hotkey-hint shows 'Ctrl+Shift+L' next to broadcast-golive-all. Task2 Multi-Channel Ducking: mc-duck-bar/mc-duck-slider/mc-duck-value all render; slider drag updates the percentage; toggling mc-mic-<id> reveals 'Music ducked for mic' via mc-ducking-<id>. Task3 Per-Channel Schedule: mc-sched-enable-<id> reveals mc-sched-time-<id> + mc-sched-golive-<id>, values persist to localStorage 'hotlive95_mc_schedules'. Task4 /live themes: /live defaults to full card (live-play-button visible), /live?theme=compact renders live-compact-bar; live-theme-toggle with live-theme-full and live-theme-compact buttons switch layouts and persist to 'hotlive95_live_theme' as full/compact. Task5 Broadcast Center per-station: station-export-listeners-<id> exists and is disabled (expected in preview); station-skin-full-<id>/station-skin-compact-<id> toggle changes copied /live link — Card copies plain link, Bar copies link with '&theme=compact'. Regression: header app-logo renders /flame-play-logo.png, Go Live button opens stations-modal, no runtime crashes, no console errors from app code.

issues: Slider display mapping seems non-linear/inverted — setting native input value=55 caused the displayed dip to jump from 80% to 95% (initial). Feature is functional (value updates and ducking indicator toggles), but the min/max/step or inverted scale of mc-duck-slider may be confusing to DJs. Please double-check the range mapping.

action_items: Minor: React hydration warning 'In HTML, <span> cannot be a child of <option>' fires from StationsModal bit-rate <select> at StationsModal.js line ~407. This is caused by Emergent preview overlay injecting instrumentation spans into <option> — safe to ignore in preview, but if it also fires in production build, wrap option labels in plain text (avoid dynamic expression inside <option>).
Minor UX: consider clarifying whether the duck slider represents 'how far music dips' or 'ducked music level'; the numeric mapping seemed non-linear during automated drag.
critical_code_review_comments: StationsModal <option> children triggering hydration warning — audit any conditional/dynamic children inside <select><option> elements to keep them as pure strings.
Duck slider (mc-duck-slider) mapping: verify input min/max/step so a native value=55 corresponds intuitively to 55% dip.

Multi-Channel Studio Mic button uses no data-testid for the visual state; the 'mc-ducking-<id>' element serves as the only test-visible confirmation — acceptable, but adding aria-pressed on mc-mic-<id> would help.
